tweets.text: Photon now handles all retrieval and ranking across Perplexity, replacing the open-source engine we used before. https://t.co/7lnutfVhR6

Fast Search spends less compute on ranking than the default preset. It's perfect for most day-to-day agentic tasks.

On our internal tests of long-tail and broad-coverage queries, it scores 0.24 points lower on relevance and about 3 percentage points lower on answer availability. https://t.co/EP54SjqSsj
